per_view.notes: Slender tapered fuselage with front hump ending in front third; cockpit region and window line present. Tall dark-blue swept fin plus horizontal stabilizer. Nose and main gear deployed. Engines cluster tightly near belly/wing root, hard to resolve four distinct nacelles with proper spacing or forward offset. Coherent grey/blue livery.

Slender light fuselage with rounded nose and tail cone, blue swept vertical fin, blue cheatline and window-dot band. A raised upper-deck block sits mid-forward, not clearly faired from the cockpit. Engines read as a blocky cluster of ~2 under the wing, not four distinct underslung nacelles. Nose and main gear with wheels present.

Head-on: four dark nacelles under wings with plausible spacing, tall blue vertical fin, thin horizontal stabilizer bar. Raised nose crown reads as hump with faint cockpit region. Light fuselage, grey wings/engines coherent. Landing gear is a blocky cluster of small trucks, slightly messy. Almost no window/door detail visible.

Rear head-on: rounded grey fuselage cross-section, four dark nacelles slung under swept wings with dihedral, thin dark-blue vertical fin plus horizontal stabilizers. Blocky main-gear/nose-gear wheel cluster below body. No visible windows or doors. Hump barely readable from this angle; fin is overly thin.

Top-down: four dark-inlet nacelles, two per swept tapering wing, sitting near leading edge with tight inboard/outboard spacing. Slender tapering fuselage but visible segment seams/color-band steps. Swept fin plus horizontal stabilizers present. Faint dashed window line and one door outline. Upper hump barely readable from above; livery light body, grey wings, blue tail stripe.

Slender white fuselage with tapered nose/tail cone, four underslung pylon-mounted nacelles, swept tapering wings with dihedral. Tall dark-blue swept fin plus horizontal stabilizers. Nose and main gear visible. Faint blue cheatline and window hints. Upper-deck hump only a subtle front bulge, weakening the 747 read.

White slender fuselage with upswept tail cone and front upper-deck hump. Tall blue swept fin plus swept tailplanes at tail. Swept tapered wings with dihedral. Engine pods and main-gear wheels cluster densely near the wing-root/belly, hard to resolve as four cleanly underslung nacelles; looks crowded/floating. Window lines and blue stripe present; coherent livery.

Front-quarter hump present, slender grey fuselage with blue window/cheat line and tall blue fin. Engine nacelles cluster centrally under the belly rather than spaced on pylons across the swept wings; count reads as two-three visible, bunched. Nose gear plus clustered main-gear bogies show. Some parts look crowded/floating near the wing root.

Four pylon-mounted nacelles under swept dihedral wings. Slender tapering fuselage, blue cheatline, blue tail fin, grey wings/engines. Nose gear plus main-gear bogies visible. Main-deck window line, cockpit windows, doors present. Hump starts at nose but appears to extend past the front third; its surface texture reads rough/seamed.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Window and door lines' (mean 5.33/10). Target the 8 anchor: a consistent passenger-window line along the main deck plus cockpit windows, door hints; then the 10 anchor: clean main-deck window line, separate upper-deck windows on the hump, cockpit windshield shape, evenly spaced doors.
